formulaContext: Each formula is a JS expression evaluated with node vm.runInNewContext(formula, Object.assign({}, params, claim.params || {})); every key of params is a bare global. Money in the teaching object is £k; Maersk money is US$.

sources.S1: Reinertsen, D. G. The Principles of Product Development Flow. Celeritas, 2009. Ch. 2 (cost of delay); WSJF = cost of delay ÷ duration.
sources.S2: Arnold, J. J. & Yüce, Ö. Black Swan Farming Using Cost of Delay. Agile Conference 2013, IEEE, pp. 101-116, doi:10.1109/AGILE.2013.16.
sources.S3: Arnold, J. J. Cost of Delay. Black Swan Farming, https://blackswanfarming.com/cost-of-delay/ (Maersk feature: 82 h, 46 wk, 38 wk queues, > $200,000/wk, nearly $8m).
sources.S4: Arnold & Yüce, authors' repost, https://blackswanfarming.com/black-swan-farming-using-cost-of-delay/ (150 days average; 24 % over a year).
sources.S5: Smith, W. E. Various optimizers for single-stage production. Naval Research Logistics Quarterly 3(1-2), 1956, 59-66, doi:10.1002/nav.3800030106.
sources.T: Declared teaching object: stated values, not data (brief.md).
